work.name: User Liveness Detection
work.summary: Reviewed the current state of face anti-spoofing research, fine-tuned a MobileNet-based liveness detection model, and integrated it into the live customer-facing identity verification app as microservices on AWS SageMaker.

work.name: Medical Image Analysis Platform
work.summary: Built CNN-based models for medical image segmentation, classification and anomaly detection, deployed behind Flask services, orchestrated through AWS SageMaker and integrated in real time with the platform. The models improved diagnostic accuracy by 25% and reduced false positives.

work.name: Evacuation Risk Assessment
work.summary: Built predictive models to assess medical and political evacuation risk, and presented the outputs through Power BI for non-technical users. Data processing and workflow automation ran on Azure Data Factory and Databricks.

work.name: Sentiment Analysis with BERT
work.summary: Built a BERT-based sentiment analysis model and integrated it into a production voice platform.

work.name: OCR Document Parsing
work.summary: Designed deep learning and OCR models in Python for automated document parsing, replacing manual data entry, with microservices in ASP.NET and C# handling requests.
